state.task:
Question-answering task over a company handbook.

The handbook is in /task/fixtures/handbook/ (40 documents, HB-01.md to HB-40.md). Each document
has a header line (version, status, effective dates, what it supersedes) and numbered sections;
each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded versions, and
memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the situation and
date in the question.

Tools (in your code):
  import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "/task/fixtures")
  from handbook_tools import search, show
  search("lodging limit Geneva", k=5)   # up to k (at most 8) ranked passages, with ids
  show(["HB-07 §2", "HB-12 §3"])        # the named passages in full
Every search result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (the path is printed in
the result header). You may also read the documents directly.

Questions:
- Q1: What is the mileage rate for a business trip in a private electric car today? (answer in cents per km)
- Q2: What is the daily meal allowance for a standard travel day today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR per day)
- Q3: What is the relocation lump sum for a regular employee relocating at the company's request with dependent children today? (answer in EUR)
- Q4: What monthly mobile allowance applied to a regular employee using a private phone on 2026-01-15? (answer in EUR per month)
- Q5: What is the purchase approval threshold for a regular department's purchase from a supplier with a framework contract today? (answer in EUR)
- Q6: What is the nightly lodging limit for a contractor on a business trip to Geneva today? (answer in EUR per night)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the
rule and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.query: monthly mobile allowance a regular employee using a private phone 2026-01-15
state.step_intent: Find the monthly mobile allowance that applies to: What monthly mobile allowance applied to a regular employee using a private phone on 2026-01-15?

passages.source: HB-06 §4 | Policy FAQ — Current monthly mobile allowance | version: 7 · status: current · effective: 2026-01-15
passages.text: Q: What is the current standard monthly mobile allowance? A: 37 EUR per month, as set in HB-21 §2 (effective 2026-02-01). Group exceptions are listed in HB-01.

passages.source: HB-21 §2 | Communication policy: mobile phones — Standard monthly mobile allowance | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-02-01 · supersedes: HB-34
passages.text: Employees who use a private phone for work receive a mobile allowance of 37 EUR per month. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner. Employees should keep costs reasonable and book through the approved channels where possible. Audit samples are drawn every quarter, and selected employees are asked for documentation.

passages.source: HB-34 §2 | Communication policy: mobile phones — Standard monthly mobile allowance | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-04-01 to the day before 2026-02-01 · superseded by: HB-21
passages.text: Employees who use a private phone for work receive a mobile allowance of 27 EUR per month. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header. Claims that combine several costs must list each cost on a separate line of the claim. Supporting records are kept for seven years in line with the retention schedule.

passages.source: HB-06 §7 | Policy FAQ — Current home-office equipment allowance | version: 7 · status: current · effective: 2026-01-15
passages.text: Q: What is the current standard home-office equipment allowance? A: 400 EUR, as set in HB-30 §2 (effective 2026-04-01). Group exceptions are listed in HB-15.

passages.source: HB-01 §3 | Memo: monthly mobile allowance exceptions — Carve-out | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-04-01
passages.text: The exception above does not apply to field engineers on a company-paid phone contract; they follow the standard monthly mobile allowance in HB-21 §2. Claims are submitted in the expense tool within 30 days of the date the cost was incurred. Employees should keep costs reasonable and book through the approved channels where possible. Managers may reject claims that are not supported by the documentation described here.
